meta.title: 5 things the Stoics did every single morning

Caspar David Friedrich mountains morning light painting

beats.text: Five things the Stoics did every morning — before the world got to them.
One. They pictured what might go wrong today — so nothing could ambush them.
Two. They named what was in their control, and quietly released the rest.
Three. They decided who they'd be today — before the day decided for them.
Four. They reminded themselves they'd meet difficult people — and chose patience in advance.
Five. They remembered the day was borrowed, not owed — and that made it matter.
Win the first hour, the Stoics knew, and you've already half-won the day.

source_note: Inspired by Marcus Aurelius, Seneca & Epictetus.
